## Scope

- Paper result or infrastructure change:
- Exact source locator, if mathematical:
- Public declaration semantics changed: yes / no

## Verification

- [ ] `lake build`
- [ ] focused `#print axioms` audit

## Semantic review

Describe changes to assumptions, quantifiers, representation orientation,
normalization, indexing, endpoints, and exceptional cases. Write “none” only
after checking each category.
